items.title: Dominic James "Nick" La Rocca Interview, 1958-05-26
items.q: Rager's name is on some of them. But he did nothing but just hold the chords down on the piano, which I gave him to play.

ctx.x: Well, I'll tell you why I did that. The reason I did that, because I had so many numbers on my name. And I had to share with the guys in the band. You understand what I mean? I tried to look out for myself. Up to this time, these fellas rode my back. They composed not only with Shields, who collaborated on some of the numbers. Rager's name is on some of them. But he did nothing but just hold the chords down on the piano, which I gave him to play. Shields collaborated. And on the numbers that Shields collaborated,…
But Shields was a real collaborator. Yes.
